Lag/estimation/graph-input-transfer/mismatch and nonlinear set-benefit conditions, exactly-B comparator, lack of abstention/rollout guarantee and nonvacuity qualification remain intact
Main experiment narrative retains prior test inspection, exploratory follow-up scope, graph-convention differences, failed-group nulls, per-seed adverse results and limits of cost comparisons

New appendix sec:implementation-details retains checkpoint/normalization storage, additive-versus-clamped variance floors, conventional mean-loss scaling, clipping coupling and beta-NLL derivative qualifications
